stem: To report Belgium's AOV for the quarter, a regional manager takes the simple average of the nine Belgian stores' AOVs. Why can this give the wrong number?

options.text: An average of averages is always higher than the true AOV
A store with few orders counts as much as a store with many
AOV has to be computed per unit sold, never per order taken
Store AOVs include VAT, which a simple average cannot remove
